info.title: Curl HTTP Request
info.description: Send an HTTP request to any URL from our servers and receive the full response — including the status code, all response headers, and the body content. Supports GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, and HEAD. Automatically follows up to 3 redirects. Useful for testing endpoints, verifying servers are responding correctly, debugging redirect chains, or fetching raw data without needing a local setup.
info.x-guidance: Send a JSON body with a 'url' (required, must start with http:// or https://) and an optional 'method' field (defaults to GET). The response includes 'statusCode' (integer), 'headers' (object of key-value strings), 'body' (string, may be HTML, JSON, or plain text), 'durationMs' (how long the request took in milliseconds), and 'error' (null on success, or a plain-English message if the request could not be completed). Do not use this for private or internal network addresses. Redirects are followed automatically up to 3 times. If the target server is unreachable or times out, a 400 error is returned with a description of what went wrong.

url.title: Url
url.description: The full web address you want to send a request to. Must start with http:// or https://.

method.title: Method
method.description: The type of request to make. Choose from GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, or HEAD. Defaults to GET if not provided.

url.title: Url
url.description: The web address that was requested.

method.title: Method
method.description: The request type that was used.

statusCode.title: Statuscode
statusCode.description: The numeric status code returned by the server (for example, 200 means success, 404 means not found).

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: All the response headers sent back by the server, as key-value pairs.

body.title: Body
body.description: The full text body returned by the server. May be HTML, JSON, plain text, or empty for HEAD requests.

durationMs.title: Durationms
durationMs.description: How long the request took in milliseconds from start to finish.

redirectChain.title: Redirectchain
redirectChain.description: The list of URLs visited during any automatic redirects, from the first address through to the final destination.

error.title: Error
error.description: Null if the request succeeded. A plain-English description of what went wrong if the request could not be completed.
